visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a woman staring intensely at the lens, her facial muscles tensed in an expression of exaggerated fury. She is wearing a simple blue crew-neck shirt. Behind her is a shelf filled with various Kaiju action figures, notably a large Godzilla. Red flame animations and white focus lines overlay the scene to emphasize her anger. (2) She brings two pink Chiikawa blind box packages into the frame, holding them up for the viewer to see. She speaks with rapid hand gestures, showing the front of the boxes. The lighting is a bright, neutral studio-style light that illuminates her face and the product packaging clearly. (3) Close-up shots focus on the 'Usagi' character plush. The woman's hands manipulate the yellow fabric, pointing out the pale, sickly yellow color of the plastic face. She tries to rotate the face, but the mechanism appears stiff and difficult to move under her thumb's pressure. (4) The camera focuses on a blue 'Hachiware' plush. The woman uses her finger to point at a bald patch on the top of the toy's head, where the blue fabric fails to cover the white plastic base. She then points to a protruding white plastic stud on the toy's belly, suggesting a manufacturing error. (5) The woman holds up two boxes side-by-side to compare the printing quality. The box on the left has a visible Miniso logo and sharper graphics, while the one on the right looks blurry and lacks official branding. She points between the two, highlighting the clear difference in authenticity. (6) She demonstrates the authentic blue plush toy. The plastic face rotates with an extremely smooth, effortless motion as she pushes it with her thumb. The fabric looks much plusher and the colors are more vibrant. Her facial expression shifts from frustration to a satisfied smile. (7) A split-screen visual appears, with the left side labeled 'Authentic' in Chinese characters and the right side labeled 'Counterfeit.' She holds both the real and fake yellow plushies up to the camera, moving them slightly to show the dramatic difference in color saturation and overall build quality. (8) In the final scene, she holds both authentic plushies (blue and yellow) close to her face. She smiles warmly at the camera and gives a final demonstration of the smooth face-changing feature. The video ends with a quick cut as she finishes her recommendation.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a loud, high-pitched female exclamation of '真的要氣死!', characterized by high vocal arousal and intense volume. The background music is an upbeat, high-tempo electronic pop track with a strong 4/4 beat. A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect punctuates the start. (2) The speaker narrates her experience buying blind boxes online. Her voice has a high pitch and fast speech rate. The sound of cardboard boxes being tapped and rustled is clearly audible. The BGM remains consistent with a steady synthesizer melody and percussive rhythm. (3) As she demonstrates the fake yellow toy, the audio captures a dry, plastic friction sound and a heavy, struggling 'click' as the face is forced to turn. Her tone becomes sarcastic and disappointed. The acoustic texture is clean with a very high signal-to-noise ratio. (4) She points out defects in the blue toy, and the audio includes a sharp 'ding' sound effect when she mentions the 'balding' head. Her vocal delivery is animated and comedic. Short, percussive impact sounds are added in post-production to highlight specific visual flaws. (5) A transitional 'swish' SFX leads to a shift in her vocal tone, which becomes more positive and relieved. She describes the authentic Miniso product. The sound of the new toy's face rotating is a light, smooth mechanical 'zip' sound, suggesting high-quality components. (6) During the comparison phase, her voice becomes authoritative and critical of the counterfeiters. The BGM swells slightly in volume. The audio mix is well-balanced, with the high-energy speech sitting clearly above the persistent, bright electronic background music and occasional comedy sound effects. (7) The final conclusion features a friendly, warm vocal tone. She recommends the official product. The BGM fades out with a final melodic flourish and a soft 'pop' sound effect, marking the end of the recording. The overall dynamic range is compressed for social media broadcasting.
